question.problem: Erika has a crayon box with $36$ different colors. She wants to draw each side of a square with a different color. How many possible choices of colors does Erika have?
question.worked_solution:
The number of permutations of $n$ objects taken $r$ at a time is given by the formula

$$
{}_{n}{P}_{r}=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!}.
$$

There are $36$ colors to choose from, so $n=36.$ We want to select $4$ of those colors to draw the sides of the square, so we have $r=4.$

Therefore, the number of possible choices is

$$
\begin{aligned}{}_{36}{P}_{4} & =\frac{36!}{(36-4)!} \\  & =\frac{36!}{32!} \\  & =\frac{36\cdot 35\cdot 34\cdot 33\cdot \cancel{32!}}{\cancel{32!}} \\  & =36\cdot 35\cdot 34\cdot 33 \\  & =1\,413\,720.\end{aligned}
$$
